entries.title: DRAFT: joint Poisson uniform integrability and pathwise absolute continuity
entries.statement: DRAFT, independent review pending. Let omega -> mu_omega be a measurable kernel of probability measures on R on a standard probability space, let I be a bounded open interval, and put f_eta(omega,E)=integral eta/[pi((E-t)^2+eta^2)] dmu_omega(t). Almost-sure absolute continuity of mu_omega on I is equivalent to: for every closed positive-length interval J compactly contained in I, lim_{M->infinity} sup_{0<eta<1} E integral_J f_eta 1_{f_eta>M} dE=0. This is joint uniform integrability in (omega,E), not just boundedness of the averaged density. Full draft proof in the owner campaign source; no Anderson-model estimate is asserted.

entries.title: DRAFT: absolute continuity without any higher Poisson moment bound
entries.statement: DRAFT, independent review pending. The density g(E)=1/[E(log(1/E))^2] on (0,exp(-1)), zero elsewhere, integrates to one and lies in no Lp for p>1. Multiplication by E on L2(g(E)dE) is a bounded self-adjoint operator whose unit-vector spectral measure is g(E)dE. Its normalized Poisson densities converge in L1 and are uniformly integrable, but their pth energy moments diverge as eta tends to zero for every p>1 on any interval containing the support in its interior. Thus a higher-moment sufficient condition is stronger than spectral absolute continuity; failure to prove it is not a refutation of the Anderson conjecture.

entries.title: DRAFT: C0056 spectral bridge and separate GOE gap
entries.statement: DRAFT, independent review pending. For the bounded nearest-neighbor Anderson Hamiltonian H=-A+lambda V on l2(Z^3), iid V_x uniform on [-1,1], and lambda>0 fixed, local joint uniform integrability of normalized Im G_00(E+i eta) down to eta=0 on an open interval implies spectral absolute continuity there by stationarity and the countable site basis. Nonzero spectral weight requires a separate premise. Uniform higher Poisson moments, or the independent prover's cavity inverse-moment bound, are sufficient stronger hypotheses; none is proved here for this model. An upper first averaged Poisson moment is insufficient. C0056's intake also requests GOE finite-volume statistics, which this bridge does not establish.
